claim: In the matching retail DLL, MatchMisc.CriticalCheck (0x06004949) is a static two-Int32-parameter method returning Boolean, with parameters named atk_pl_idx and def_pl_idx and an exact 678-byte body. It returns false when MatchSetting.CriticalRate is zero, either resolved Player is absent, either Player has isIntruder set, either Player has isSecond set, or the attacker animation is looped. It loads attacker WrestlerParam.criticalType. When that value is zero, it requires attacker isCriticalMove and raw CurrentSkill.flags mask 1; when nonzero, it requires CurrentSkill.flags to overlap MatchMisc.Critical_CheckTbl[criticalType]. It then builds three Float32 factors from MatchData.mCriticalTypeTbl1 using defender reversalType, MatchData.mCriticalTypeTbl2 using attacker fightStyle, and MatchData.mCriticalRateTbl using defender GetHealth(HP), each divided by 100.0. A fourth factor begins at 1.0 and, only for nonzero criticalType, can become 0.5 from defender spSkillFlags mask 512 under Critical_CheckTbl masks 2/8/32, or 0.25 from defender spSkillFlags mask 1024 on the alternate branch. The product is then modified by the exact attacker spSkillFlags-4 / HP / SP branch, MatchSetting.CriticalRate values 1 or 3, and the exact S1-rule branch. Finally it samples MatchRandom.Range(0.0f,1.0f) and returns true unless that sampled value is greater than the computed product. FACT-0020 pins the ApplyDamage call boundary at IL+0x01C5 and its true/false split around this exact method.
